Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value true, only when the response is a replay of the answer stored for the Idempotency-Key.

schema.description: Exactly one of the two label kinds, never a mix. An outbound label answers Label (poNumber and assignmentId always present, no purpose); a reverse label (ADR 0017) answers ReturnLabel (purpose RETURN and returnAuthorizationId always present, no poNumber, no assignmentId). The required properties tell the two apart.

oneOf.description: Label metadata. Never contains the ship-to address. labelRef, trackingNumber and carrier are what vendor-connectivity returns to the vendor.
oneOf.title: Label

oneOf.description: Metadata of a reverse label, the label of one package of a customer return (ADR 0017). Never contains the ship-to address. A reverse label has no purchase order and no fulfillment assignment, so it carries neither poNumber nor assignmentId; it always carries purpose RETURN and the returnAuthorizationId it belongs to. orderId is the outbound order whose ship-to is the return's pickup address.

purpose.description: Always RETURN. An outbound label (the Label schema) has no purpose property.

returnAuthorizationId.description: The return authorization the reverse label belongs to.

oneOf.title: ReturnLabel

400.description: idempotency-key-required (the Idempotency-Key header is missing) or idempotency-key-invalid (not 1-128 printable ASCII characters).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

404.description: not-found. The addressed label or journey does not exist.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

409.description: void-after-handover (ErrVoidAfterHandover), journey-closed (ErrJourneyClosed, the package's journey is already closed, for example delivered), concurrent-update (ErrConcurrentUpdate) or idempotency-key-reused (the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

422.description: validation-failed. The request is well-formed JSON but violates a value rule. It is not stored under the Idempotency-Key; the key is released and a retry with the same key is validated again.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

500.description: internal-error. An unmapped failure; the detail never carries the cause. Never cached by the idempotency middleware, so the same key retries the work.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.
